about: Completion repair integration (2026-11-06): the completion corpus re-pinned once on the integrated tree (tests/fixtures/gi4/completion/corpus.json). Every entry whose pinned verdict or reading moved, with its pinned verdict before and after; measured by ops.gi4.completion --report before --repin. Group E (16 entries) is new: its baseline verdicts were read on the installed tree. One requirement is revised with its reason (C4M|C4-2:C4-2-4a, required_revised). Invariant: no FALSE READY where the installed baseline had none (0).
